top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a physically stated principle, a small molecule inducing a ternary complex so the cell's own ubiquitin machinery degrades a chosen protein, shown by design (PROTACs) and by drug-reshaped ligase surfaces (cereblon, which explains thalidomide action). The mechanism is reproduced independently across many laboratories and E3 ligases, so maturity does not depend on an approved drug. The cost is that Ciulli's VHL and ternary-complex structural work is left out and the two lineages share one citation, but the citation can name one achievement with two entry routes. P002 has the cleanest attribution but is arguably the same catalytic manifold as 2010, and P003 sits close to the 2020 CRISPR prize with Target-AID attribution unresolved.
